global_availability: DermGPT is available for dermatologists and it's free to use. [SOURCE 2]
summary: DermGPT is an AI chatbot designed to streamline clinical tasks, improve access to dermatologic data, and save time for physicians. It is built on more than 3,000 peer-reviewed articles. [SOURCE 2, 4]
keywords: AI; chatbot; dermatology; clinical efficiency; patient education; prior authorizations
intended_use_and_workflow: DermGPT is intended to provide quick access to dermatology information, assist with patient management, create patient education handouts, and answer patient inquiries. It can be used to look up diagnoses, treatments, and prior authorization criteria. [SOURCE 4]
primary_intended_users: Dermatologists, RNs, MAs, and ancillary staff. [SOURCE 4]
necessary_knowledge_expertise: Dermatology providers and staff can utilize this trusted source of information to help serve a patient. [SOURCE 4]
how_to_use: Dermatologists can sign up at www.dermgpt.com and start using it clinically. [SOURCE 2]
patient_consent_or_disclosure_required_o: DermGPT can provide informed consent language regarding procedures and telehealth consults [SOURCE 4].
developer_supplied_warnings: DermGPT does not replace medical care or decision-making; it should not be used as a stand-alone decision maker, but as an assistant. [SOURCE 4]
model_limitations: DermGPT is most powerful when paired with a dermatology provider or staff who can complement its skills with their higher-level creative problem-solving [SOURCE 4]. It does not replace medical care or decision-making and should not be used as a stand-alone decision maker, but as an assistant [SOURCE 4].
ai_system_facts: DermGPT is an AI chatbot built on over 3,000 peer-reviewed articles designed to provide dermatologists with quick access to dermatology information and assist with clinical tasks [SOURCE 2, 4]. It helps with prior authorizations, denial letters, board study, and patient education handouts [SOURCE 2].
model_type: AI chatbot based on learned language model [SOURCE 2].
interaction_with_other_systems: DermGPT can integrate with existing EHR systems to streamline documentation and facilitate seamless information exchange [SOURCE 4].
outcomes_and_output: DermGPT provides relevant and helpful answers to questions in natural language, like a real-life colleague [SOURCE 4]. It is used to look up dermatology information including diagnoses, treatments, and prior authorization criteria [SOURCE 4]. It also provides patient education and assists with prescription programs [SOURCE 4].
type_and_value_of_solution_output: DermGPT provides quick reference for medication options, dosing, and interactions; Summarizes diagnosis and treatment guidelines for complex cases; Suggests appropriate labs, imaging, and procedures for diagnostic workups; Automates documentation such as visit notes, orders, and prescriptions [SOURCE 4]. It also helps create patient handouts regarding drugs, after-care, and more [SOURCE 4].
explanation_for_how_an_output_is_generat: DermGPT pulls information from trusted, physician-approved sources and a proprietary database instead of relying on the general internet [SOURCE 4]. The curated data helps to mitigate errors and provide more reliable and trustworthy results [SOURCE 2, 4].
foundation_models_used_in_application_if: DermGPT is built on a large language model with a proprietary database [SOURCE 4]. It is based on over 3,000 peer-reviewed articles [SOURCE 2].
input_data_source: The input data source is a proprietary database of over 3,000 peer-reviewed dermatology articles [SOURCE 2, 4].
output_input_data_type: Natural language queries for input; dermatology information, summaries, guidelines, and automated documentation for output [SOURCE 4].
development_data_characterization: The AI chatbot is built on more than 3,000 peer-reviewed articles [SOURCE 2].
training_data: Trained on over 3,000 peer-reviewed dermatology articles [SOURCE 2].
dataset_transparency: DermGPT only pulls from trusted, physician-approved sources [SOURCE 4].
relevance_of_training_data_to_intended_p: DermGPT is trained on over 3,000 peer-reviewed articles, making it specific and reliable for dermatology-related questions.
bias_mitigation_approaches: DermGPT uses a proprietary database of physician-approved sources to avoid the errors and hallucinations that can occur with general language models.
ongoing_maintenance: The DermGPT platform is continuously updated and improved [SOURCE 4].
transparency_information: DermGPT pulls information from trusted, physician-approved sources instead of using a general language model [SOURCE 4].
usefulness_efficacy_goal_of_metrics: The goal of DermGPT is to improve patient care and streamline dermatology practices by assisting with clinical tasks and making dermatology information readily available.
usefulness_efficacy_result: DermGPT can save dermatologists time, leading to more efficient patient care, decreased wait times, and less physician burnout.
usefulness_efficacy_interpretation: DermGPT assists with tasks like prior authorizations, denial letters, and patient education handouts, making it a valuable tool for dermatologists and their staff.
peer_reviewed_publications: DermGPT is built on more than 3,000 peer-reviewed articles [SOURCE 2].
stakeholders_consulted_during_design_of_: In episode 10 of The Future of Dermatology Podcast, Dr. Fara chats with Vishi Hawkes, MBA, of Regeneron about a conversation around barriers, stakeholders, and connections between patients, doctors, and everyone else who is involved in our personal healthcare [SOURCE 1].
